summary: Combine the two owner blind sheets (20 items) to validate the annotator and freeze the useful threshold. Binary agreement is 95% at useful=relevance>=2 (1 false positive, 0 false negatives) versus 80% at >=3, so >=2 is frozen in EVALUATION.md. Re-scores experiment 2: P@5 saturates at 1.00, but P@10 separates the recency baseline (0.60) from both profile systems (1.00). E-LLM-LABEL-VALIDITY stays not_run (n=20, post-hoc threshold); E-RANKING stays not_run.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 1e978e1. Scorer + tests + docs/registry; cached labels, no network calls.

budget_impact.rationale: No runtime or model call; only local sheets and cached labels were compared. Runtime operations/ceilings unchanged.
budget_impact.before: Two thresholds in play; experiment 2 read as either discriminating (>=3) or not (>=2).
budget_impact.after: Useful threshold frozen at annotator>=2 (95% binary agreement); experiment 2 reads as P@5 saturated, P@10 profile>recency, keyword vs TF-IDF tied.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: Corrected experiment-2 metrics under the frozen threshold

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; scorer/docs plumbing only; labels are the owner's

open_risks: Threshold chosen post-hoc on 20 items; pre-registers only for future candidate sets.
Annotator graded scale unusable; only binary labels are usable.
P@10 comparison rests on 10 labelled items per system; not statistical.
